title: JEET-repro: reproduction package for sparse AC-loss calibration --- evaluation variants, denominator swap, and figure pipeline
description: Code and reduced data to reproduce every figure, the Section 5.1 self-consistency checks, and the headline error numbers of the paper 'Efficient AC Winding Loss Calibration via Sparse Full Finite-Element Analysis and Separable Radial Basis Function for Scaled Traction Motor Design' (submitted to the Journal of Electrical Engineering & Technology). The package supplements the raw-data deposit 10.5281/zenodo.21775297, which holds the full per-operating-point solver exports; this repository carries the calibration library, the figure and verification scripts, and the reduced inputs they read.
